conventions.coupon: 4% annual rate paid semiannually, unadjusted dates, 30/360 Bond Basis
conventions.discounting: Actual/365 Fixed; continuously compounded NSS zero rates
conventions.instrument: hypothetical USD fixed-rate bonds; no real security identifiers
conventions.risk: constant current cash flows; no passage of time, credit/liquidity/reinvestment/financing effects
conventions.shock: additive spot-rate shifts; piecewise linear at 2/5/10/30Y, flat beyond endpoints

source.attribution: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System; Gürkaynak, Sack and Wright (2006/2007). Data downloaded from the recorded third-party mirror, not directly from the Board.
source.status: Staff research estimates of off-the-run nominal Treasury curves, not an official statistical release or observed traded bond prices.
source.units: BETA and SVENY in percent; TAU in years; Date in ISO format
source.vintage: Pinned current-vintage mirror; historical values can be revised. Not a historical-publication-time dataset.
